profile.name: SR830 锁相放大器
profile.description: SR830 是一款用于相敏检测和微弱交流信号测量的锁相放大器。该驱动通过 GPIB/串口控制参考源、频率、谐波、输入耦合、灵敏度、时间常数、滤波器、显示/前面板输出、模拟输入输出以及内部数据缓冲与存储功能。
profile.description_en: The SR830 is a lock-in amplifier for phase-sensitive detection and measurement of weak AC signals. This driver controls the instrument over GPIB/serial, including reference source, frequency, harmonic, input coupling, sensitivity, time constant, filters, display/front-panel outputs, analog I/O, and the internal data buffer and storage functions.
